title: Training Video
sub: Plan and record the training video for a finished FBA and BIP: the script drafted from the case (the student, the target behaviors and their definitions, the function, the goals, the reinforcers), the cards that go on screen beside each paragraph, a teleprompter for the iPad with a clicker, the graphics drawn here (cards, lower thirds, photos) in a window of their own, and an export in the layout of the Google Sheet that drives Flowics.
